test: for t in diagrams_live notes_live; do nvim --headless -u NONE -i NONE -l tests/$t.lua || exit 1; done

mutations.name: diagram events reach the note code
own save reloads
mutations.replace: if diagram.updated_at == baseline then return end

mutations.name: unsaved edits are overwritten
mutations.replace:
if vim.bo[bufnr].modified then
      mark_conflict(bufnr)
      return
    end

mutations.name: obsolete responses are applied
mutations.replace: if vim.b[bufnr].pandora_updated_at ~= baseline then return end

mutations.name: edits made while fetching are lost
mutations.replace: if vim.api.nvim_buf_get_changedtick(bufnr) ~= tick then return end

mutations.name: older requests are not superseded
mutations.replace: if pending[id] ~= request then return end

mutations.name: deleted diagrams do not warn
mutations.replace: vim.notify('Diagram ' .. event.id .. ' was deleted on Pandora.', vim.log.levels.WARN)

mutations.name: failed fetches are silent
mutations.replace: vim.notify('Could not refresh diagram ' .. id .. ': ' .. (err or 'request failed'), vim.log.levels.WARN)

mutations.name: reconcile ignores open diagrams
mutations.replace: if id then refresh(id, bufnr) end
